newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Guoco Group unit closes US$180 mln FRN.
newsitem.headline: Guoco Group unit closes US$180 mln FRN.

text.p: Fresco Resources Ltd's US$180 million floating rate notes issue has been closed, said arranger Fuji International Finance.

The five-year notes, guaranteed by Guoco Group, were issued at par and re-offered at a fixed 99.40. They pay a coupon of 80 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate. With fees, the all-in return for top tier managers is 95 basis points.

Arrangers are Bayerische Landesbank Hong Kong, with US$17.5 million, and Banque Nationale de Paris, BZW Asia, Fuji International Finance, JP Morgan Securites Asia and Sumitomo Finance Asia, with US$16.5 million each.
Co-arrangers, with US$13 million each, are HYPO-Bank, Hamburgische Landesbank, KEB Asia and LTCB Asia.
Co-lead manager Bank Brussels Lambert committed to US$8 million.
Senior managers, with US$5 million each, are Agricultural Bank of China, Banco Exterior de Espana and Keppel Bank of Singapore.
Managers are CIC Paris, with US$3 million, and Bank of China's Singapore Branch, with US$2 million. Signing is set for October 9. The payment date is October 16.
